camera_setups: 24mm inverted crane view beneath the bridge tower, whale projection filling the sky

images.camera_strategy: Inverted low-angle bridge shot with the cat dominating the foreground and the whale silhouette towering behind.
images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5, a mobile-thumbnail-readable blockbuster rescue tableau in a Prehistoric valley, at a wind-battered suspension bridge tower above a miniature city. The dominant protagonist is an attractive adult Korean Shorthair orange-and-white cheese-tabby cat with a natural, balanced, sturdy build; bright warm cheese-orange short fur with realistic darker orange tabby stripes; large natural upright ears; a broad clean white blaze running from the forehead down between the eyes toward the pink nose; clean white fur around the mouth and muzzle, on the chin, continuing naturally down the entire neck, chest and belly; all four paws and lower feet covered in clean white fur like four neat white boots, with the white fur rising naturally from the toes and clearly visible whenever the paws are shown; a distinctive small congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around parts of the mouth area, naturally integrated into the otherwise white muzzle, explicitly a permanent fur pattern and never food, dirt or staining; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense realistic fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. The cat is the disaster-film first responder, suspended safely upside down in an upside-down hang from a transparent studio support, gripping an unbranded aerodynamic hero shield toward the camera. A huge whale-like projection rises beside the observation window during the Whale-scale encounter, visibly causing the cat's guilty caught-in-the-act expression, while two distinct supporting cats watch from the miniature bridge crowd. The apparent monster visibly bows to the fearless cat as the outcome: the monster bows to the fearless cat. Show colossal landmark scale, bridge cables, city silhouettes, shield, projection rays, windblown debris, and strong facial reaction as readable impact cues. The twist is that the crowd is made of distinct supporting cats. Use one decisive action: the cat plants the shield against the projected whale beam. Three-quarter viewpoint, 24mm lens, extreme low angle, crisp cat and shield, deep layered depth of field, stormy blue backlight and warm rescue strobes. Realistic fur, paws, whiskers, reflections, shadows, safe forced perspective and harmless VFX compositing; no actual falling, no distress, no logos, no text, no watermark, no cartoon, no illustration, no 3D render, no malformed anatomy, no duplicate limbs.
